name: Tennessee Leadership Summit
org: Tennessee Farm Bureau Federation and UT Herbert College of Agriculture
what_you_do: Spend a week in UT dorms. You meet student leaders from across Tennessee. You learn about leading, teamwork, service and Tennessee farming. The week ends with a banquet on Friday.
who_can_apply: Student leaders in Tennessee. The 2027 page does not list grades. Ask your county Farm Bureau office about sponsorship and grade rules.
pay_detail: $200. Covers class materials, meals Monday through the Friday banquet, dorm housing, transport to activities and trained counselors.
deadline_text: Summit is May 31 to June 4, 2027. The page says the application is coming soon. No deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Watch the Tennessee Farm Bureau summit page for the application. Call 931-388-7872 with questions.
notes: Check with your county Farm Bureau, since the application is still marked coming soon.
